subject: DYNAMIC LENGTH clause
notes: Format `DYNAMIC LENGTH [ dynamic-length-structure-name-1 ] [ LIMIT IS integer-1 ]` (cite.py --check 13.18.19.2 "LIMIT" OK), underlines on DYNAMIC and LIMIT only. Grammar `DYNAMIC LENGTH? cobolWord? (LIMIT IS? integerLiteral)?` matches: optional LENGTH/IS, optional structure name before optional LIMIT. Probes (pinned cobol.exe, --std 2014): `PIC X DYNAMIC LIMIT 5` runs [ABCDE]; `DYNAMIC LENGTH DLS LIMIT 3` [ABC]; `DYNAMIC DLS` accepted; `LIMIT +5` COBOL0001 and `LIMIT IS 0` COBOL2386 (cite.py --check 5.5 "shall be unsigned and nonzero unless otherwise specified" OK); `LIMIT 5.0` rejected; --std 2002 COBOL0900. --std 2023 run identical. || Editions (adjudicator): 2014, 2023 (COBOL-2014 introduction per VERSION_CHANGE_REFERENCE; the 2023 Annex E lists only the 2023 SET enhancement for dynamic-length items, E.3 item 17)
